endpoint.what_the_paper_measures: siRNA (RNAi) delivery to leukocytes, read out in the main text as gene silencing and in the SI as (a) in vivo CD45 silencing in T lymphocytes, (b) U266 cell viability after siPLK1 vs control siRNA, (c) Cy5 organ biodistribution, (d) TNS apparent-pKa titration, (e) blood-count and serum-chemistry toxicology.
endpoint.cargo: siRNA (siPLK1 therapeutic, siNC/siCon negative control, siCD45 in vivo, Cy5-siRNA for biodistribution)
endpoint.why: data/ Experiment_method vocabulary is delivery-only: luminescence_normalized, luminescence_discretized_normalized, LRP6_knockdown_normalized, protein_adundance_normalized, editing_efficiency_normalized, luminescence_relative_to_Spikevax. Cell viability, Cy5 biodistribution, TNS fluorescence, CBC and serum chemistry are none of these.

panels.why: Images with a 200 nm scale bar. No measured quantity is plotted.

panels.what: U266 cell viability (%) by XTT, LNPs with NC-siRNA at 0.06 uM, 72 h. 16 bars: UT, MC3, Lipid 1..14.
panels.why_tiers_1_4_fail: No Source Data for this DOI; the SI contains no table of these values; no repo/PMC; and page 38 has 0 vector drawing items with one DCTDecode JPEG, so there is no bond/rect geometry to read.
panels.reason_not_admissible: Cell viability under a NEGATIVE-control siRNA is a safety readout. It measures that the carrier does not kill the cell; it does not measure delivery. No Experiment_method in data/ is a viability assay.
panels.value_to_this_curation: It is the ONLY panel in the SI that covers all 14 library members individually, so it is what pins the library size at 14.

panels.what: U266 cell viability (%) by XTT, siPLK1-LNPs at 0 / 0.012 / 0.03 / 0.06 / 0.12 uM, 72 h. 12 lipids per dose group.
panels.reason_not_admissible: The readout is viability, not gene expression. It is a downstream functional CONSEQUENCE of PLK1 silencing, confounded by the carrier's own toxicity -- which is precisely why Figure S4 exists as the dose-matched control.
panels.hazard: Legend omits Lipid 8 and Lipid 10. See contradiction C-02.

panels.what: U266 cell viability (%) by XTT, siCon(=siNC)-LNPs at the same 5 doses, 72 h. Same 12 lipids.
panels.reason_not_admissible: Dose-matched safety control. Same reason as S2.
panels.hazard: ITS LEGEND ORDER AND ITS PALETTE BOTH DIFFER FROM FIGURE S3. See contradiction C-01 -- this is the finding that decides whether S3 and S4 can be paired at all.

panels.what: PI / Annexin-V-APC FACS dot plots, MC3 vs lipid 8 vs lipid 10, siPLK1 vs siNC5, 0.06 uM, 72 h
panels.why: Dot plots. Quadrant percentages would have to be read as printed glyphs; no axis-calibrated quantity is plotted as a mark whose position encodes a value.

panels.what: Cy5 biodistribution, lipid 8 and lipid 10 LNPs, 2 h post i.v.; (C) histogram 'Total signal/Area'
panels.reason_not_admissible: Biodistribution = where the particle ACCUMULATES, measured as Cy5 dye signal. It is not functional delivery and data/ carries no biodistribution readout.

panels.note: (B) and (D) have DIFFERENT y-axis maxima (400 vs 500) and (D) carries a third organ. Not interchangeable panels.

panels.reason_not_admissible: Physicochemical characterisation (apparent pKa), not a delivery measurement. data/ has no pKa column.

panels.what: In vivo CD45 gene silencing efficiency, % CD45 silencing, CD4+ and CD8+ T lymphocytes, spleen and lymph node, tLNPs vs Mock. (A) lipid 2-based tLNPs, (B) lipid 6-based tLNPs. n=4, single experiment.
panels.readout_as_printed: % CD45 silenicng [sic, misspelled on both y axes]
panels.why_tiers_1_4_fail: Same as S2; additionally this panel is one of two DCTDecode JPEGs on p.44 and carries 0 vector items.
panels.values_extractable: 16 box-and-whisker glyphs (2 lipids x 2 organs x 2 subsets x {tLNP, Mock})
panels.corpus_admissible: IN KIND YES, IN PRACTICE NO -- see blockers
blockers: ONLY 2 IONIZABLE LIPIDS (2 and 6). A per-experiment z-score over n=2 lipids is degenerate: it is +-1 by construction and carries no rank information. This is the decisive blocker.
Both are TARGETED LNPs (tLNPs, antibody-decorated), a formulation class the 79-column schema has no field for beyond fifthcomponent_*; the plain-LNP library members are not measured here.

The glyphs are BOX-AND-WHISKER, not bars. bars.bar_top requires full-width coverage down from a top rule and is documented to refuse on anything that is not a bar reaching its baseline; a box's lower edge floats. Reading a box top/median would need bespoke geometry, which this curation is instructed not to write.

panels.what: Full written synthesis + 1H NMR + ESI-MS for Lipids 1-14 and their intermediates.
panels.note: This is where the 1,745 numeric tokens mostly live: NMR shifts, integrals, coupling constants, masses, reagent quantities. They are in BODY PROSE, not tables -- pdfplumber.find_tables() returns 0 on every one of pages 1-46, which is consistent with the briefing's '0 table-like pages'.

rollup.the_one_sentence: This SI contains exactly one delivery-endpoint panel (Figure S9) and it covers 2 ionizable lipids as antibody-targeted LNPs, which cannot be z-scored as an experiment; every other quantitative panel is viability, biodistribution, physicochemistry or toxicology. The combinatorial library SCREEN is in main-text Figures 1-4, which are not in source/.
rollup.what_IS_worth_taking: The 14 ionizable-lipid STRUCTURES, each with a written synthesis and an ESI-MS anchor. Those are durable, checkable, and independent of whether the values ever arrive.
